review_candidates.title: Head of Customer Success
review_candidates.description: Мы ищем Head of Customer Success , который возьмёт на себя развитие клиентской функции компании: от трансформации существующего Support до создания с нуля направления VIP / Key Account Management . Это не классическая позиция Head of Support. У нас уже есть 24/7 Support Team и действующий Head of Support. Компания выросла, количество клиентов увеличилось, а существующая модель клиентского сервиса перестала соответствовать масштабу бизнеса. Главная задача нового руководителя — построить систему, в которой VIP-клиенты, крупные B2B-партнёры, merchants и другие high-value users получают отдельный уровень сервиса, понятный ownership и профессиональное сопровождение. Русский язык — обязательный, свободный уровень. Английский — рабочий, от B2. Чем предстоит заниматьсяСоздать VIP / Key Account направление с нуля Нужно будет: определить критерии VIP, Key Account и Strategic Account; сегментировать существующую клиентскую базу; определить уровни сервиса и SLA для разных категорий клиентов; внедрить dedicated ownership для наиболее ценных клиентов; выстроить proactive communication; создать процессы работы с VIP и high-value клиентами; сформировать и развивать команду VIP Managers; отслеживать accounts at risk и потенциальный churn; работать над retention, развитием отношений и ростом ценности существующих клиентов. Некоторые наши клиенты способны приносить компании десятки тысяч долларов прибыли, поэтому качество работы с ними напрямую влияет на бизнес. Перестроить существующий Customer Support У нас уже работает 24/7 Support Team под управлением Head of Support. Задача Head of Customer Success — не заниматься расписаниями и ежедневным контролем линии, а определить, как должна быть устроена клиентская функция компании в целом . Вам предстоит: провести аудит существующих Support-процессов; пересмотреть структуру L1 / L2 / L3; внедрить понятные SLA и стандарты качества; перестроить escalation-процессы; сократить количество ненужных handoff между отделами; внедрить QA и прозрачные сервисные метрики; определить, какие вопросы Support должен решать самостоятельно; снизить перегрузку команды за счёт улучшения процессов, automation и self-service. Внедрить end-to-end ownership Мы хотим уйти от модели: «Ваш запрос передан соответствующему отделу». Если проблема клиента требует участия Operations, Payments, Compliance, Product или Engineering, Customer Success должен оставаться владельцем коммуникации до фактического решения вопроса. В зоне ответственности: escalation matrix; severity levels; internal SLA между департаментами; работа с критическими клиентскими инцидентами; координация коммуникации с VIP-клиентами; контроль resolution; RCA по серьёзным инцидентам; предотвращение повторяющихся проблем. Customer Success не вмешивается в независимые AML / Compliance решения, но отвечает за то, чтобы клиент получал своевременную, понятную и профессиональную коммуникацию. Построить Customer Experience и Voice of Customer Также предстоит: описать customer journey; определить ключевые friction points; анализировать причины обращений и эскалаций; выявлять проблемы с API, deposits, withdrawals, KYC и другими клиентскими процессами; внедрить Customer Health для ключевых клиентов; регулярно доносить клиентскую обратную связь до Product, Operations и management; показывать не только количество проблем, но и их влияние на revenue и клиентские отношения. Кого мы ищем Нам нужен не просто сильный Support Manager. Мы ищем человека, который умеет работать одновременно с клиентами, процессами, командами и бизнес-метриками. Будет преимуществом опыт в: cryptocurrency exchanges; fintech; payments; brokerage / trading; banking; wealth management; iGaming; других 24/7 transactional businesses. Требования 5+ лет опыта в Customer Success, Account Management, Client Operations, Customer Experience или смежных направлениях; опыт управления командой или клиентской функцией; опыт работы с VIP / high-value клиентами; опыт построения или трансформации Customer Support / Customer Success процессов; понимание L1 / L2 / L3 Support; опыт построения SLA и escalation процессов; понимание retention, churn, LTV и customer economics; сильные аналитические навыки; умение работать с Product, Operations, Engineering и Compliance; способность брать ownership сложных проблем и доводить их до результата; свободный русский язык; английский от B2. Что будет считаться хорошим результатом В первые месяцы мы ожидаем: аудит текущей модели Customer Support; сегментацию клиентской базы; определение VIP / Key Account criteria; назначение ownership для наиболее ценных клиентов; запуск VIP SLA; внедрение escalation framework; запуск VIP / Key Account функции; формирование будущей структуры Customer Success команды. В дальнейшем задача роли — превратить Customer Support из преимущественно реактивной функции в систему, которая помогает компании сохранять клиентов, защищать revenue и развивать high-value accounts . Формат Full-time Remote Crypto / FinTech Head / Director level

review_candidates.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits Engineering at Monzo Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank. The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale. Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally. As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries. Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe. This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up. What You’ll Work On Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries. Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders. Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy. Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed. Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development. Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you. Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious. Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe. Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments. Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business. You should apply if You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors. You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions. You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority. You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined. You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion. You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes. You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer. You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders. You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion. The interview process After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’) Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews. At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well! Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason. How We Work 💻 Locations & Flexible Working : Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨ Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online. Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life. At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨ Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼 What’s In It For You 💰Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas 📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. 📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

Acting as the City Operations planning lead, the position ensures alignment across districts, venues, delivery partners, and operational functions, with a particular focus on major events in 2028. review_candidates.title: Development Manager, Treasury
review_candidates.description: Founded in 1909, Mehiläinen is a rapidly growing healthcare company that strongly invests in the possibilities of digitalisation and innovation. We are on a journey towards an ambitious goal: to be the leading healthcare company in Europe by 2030. Our growth story has already taken us to seven countries, driven by modern technology and the experts who make us a frontrunner in the industry. We are looking for a Development Manager, Treasury to join our Treasury and Integrations team, based in Helsinki, Kamppi. Our Treasury and Integrations team is responsible for the entire group's financing, cash management, payment operations, M&A integrations, and financial risk management. This work takes place in an international and continuously growing environment, as Mehiläinen completes several acquisitions every year, including abroad, and operates across multiple countries. Our core operations already keep the team fully occupied, which is why we are now looking for a Development Manager, Treasury to join us, with a primary focus on developing our operations. In this role you will lead and coordinate the development of Treasury's processes, systems, data capabilities and ways of working. You work closely with the Director of Treasury and M&A Integrations and the wider Treasury team, with a particular focus on supporting a financing-intensive treasury function. In this role, you will: Contribute to developing and streamlining treasury processes internationally — identifying manual steps and standardizing and streamlining processes. Create and coordinate the Treasury development roadmap, together with the Director of Treasury and M&A Integrations, from identification of improvement opportunities through implementation and follow-up. Implement automation solutions internationally and across the entire group — leveraging robotics and AI, for example in payments, reconciliations, and bank statement processing. Develop forecasting models — automating cash and working capital forecasts, improving forecast accuracy, and contributing to related monthly reporting. Take joint responsibility, together with the Treasury team, for the development of treasury systems (current systems being Treasury Systems, Nomentia Cash Management and Anaplan for forecasting) and for leveraging their features and integrations. Act as AI Product Owner for the treasury area — defining, prioritizing, and owning key AI development initiatives. Ensure data quality and consistency, as reliable data from source systems is a prerequisite for automation and forecasting. Ensure prioritization of the development portfolio based on impact and feasibility. Measure and demonstrate the benefits of development initiatives, such as time savings, automation levels, forecast accuracy, and reduced error and fraud risk. Ensure that controls and risk management are maintained or strengthened as automation progresses. Support the Treasury organization in the implementation and adoption of new tools and improved processes. Contribute to treasury system and process roll-outs in acquired companies — and take the project lead on individual roll-outs, depending on the initiative. You will work closely with our Controllers and payments teams on developing our processes and tools, as well as with the wider organization, such as IT and other finance functions. When needed, you will also act as a contact person for both domestic and international banks. The emphasis of your tasks may vary depending on the progress of development initiatives and the profile of the person recruited. Scope of impact Geographic reach : Mehiläinen operates in seven countries and completes several acquisitions every year, including abroad — your development work spans treasury processes and systems internationally, not just in Finland. Organizational reach : you work side by side with the Director of Treasury and M&A Integrations in a compact Helsinki-based team, while your solutions reach treasury teams in every country we operate in. Stakeholder network : you will collaborate closely with Controllers, the payments team, IT, and other finance functions, and act as a point of contact for both domestic and international banks. Depth of influence : as AI Product Owner for treasury, you will define and drive the group-wide direction for automation and AI initiatives in treasury — shaping how the function works, not just executing individual projects. Requirements In this Development Management role you combine strong project, process and stakeholder-management capabilities with sufficient understanding of finance and treasury to translate business needs into practical solutions. A few years of work experience in finance or treasury, and a relevant higher education degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Economics and Business Administration or Industrial Engineering and Management). A demonstrated track record of independently leading development projects or initiatives — this role is by nature more of a developer role than a traditional controller role. Experience with process automation, robotics (RPA), or applying AI solutions in a finance or treasury context — this is a key competence area for the role. Familiarity with financial systems and experience developing them; knowledge of Power BI and experience in an international or multicultural environment are considered an advantage. Excellent interpersonal skills, analytical thinking, initiative, and flexibility, along with a strong drive to grow. Attention to detail with numbers and excellent Excel skills. Basic knowledge of accounting is an advantage, as you will also participate in monthly reporting. Fluent English, as you will work daily with international stakeholders; skills in Finnish, Swedish and/or German are considered an advantage. The ability to work in a constantly changing environment across multiple development initiatives at the same time — you don't wait for ready-made assignments but identify development opportunities yourself and drive them forward. Personal success factors A growth mindset — you enjoy challenges and embrace opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. A hands-on, can-do attitude — you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take ownership. Comfort with ambiguity – you make pragmatic decisions even under pressure. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality and outcomes. A collaborative spirit that brings out the best in the people around you. Why join Mehiläinen? We are all committed to acting in line with our values, and we believe the best results come from giving our experts freedom, responsibility, community and opportunities to grow. This Development Manager role offers an opportunity to drive a broad Treasury development agenda and contribute to more efficient, scalable and data-driven processes, systems and ways of working. We offer you the opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions in a challenging and diverse role, alongside a professional and supportive team. You can enjoy a variety of activities to balance work life, and have the opportunity to work flexibly in a hybrid setup. Apply now: Send your application via the link below by 7.10.2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to interview during the application period. Please note that we do not accept applications by email. Work starts per agreement. For more information about the role, please contact: Director, Treasury and M&A integrations Satu Sneck Satu.sneck@mehilainen.fi
